summary: BLOQUE 2 (security hardening) fully validated. Backend: 42/42 tests pass (17 new BLOQUE 2 + 25 previous regression). Verified: (1) POST /api/like server-side validation for mode-not-enabled and amor gender/age compatibility returns 403 with Spanish messages; (2) /api/pass blocks bidirectionally when a block exists; (3) messages & propose-plan after a block return 403/404 (match deleted); (4) message rate limit triggers 429 after 60/min in group chat; (5) CORS: allowed origin echoed correctly on OPTIONS from FastAPI middleware at localhost:8001 (edge/Cloudflare adds ACAO=* at the public URL, which is an ingress-layer thing outside the app); (6) /api/files/{path} requires auth via Bearer or ?auth= query, invalid token 401; (7) POST /api/report rejects invalid category with 422, sets priority='high' for ofrece_sustancias and 'normal' otherwise; (8) GET /api/admin/reports sorts high-open first. Frontend: verified Cata_23 Unsplash portrait renders correctly in Descubrir/Amor mode (naturalWidth=800), Perfil uploaded photo fetched via /api/files/*?auth=<token> returns 200 (no 401 errors), Report modal shows 5 Spanish-labeled category buttons with data-testid=report-cat-*, Admin Reportes tab shows 3 high-priority reports first with red border and data-testid=priority-high-<id> pill '🚨 Alta prioridad'.

minor.issue: Cloudflare/K8s ingress injects Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on OPTIONS, overriding the FastAPI CORSMiddleware. App-level CORS is correct (verified via localhost:8001). If strict CORS at edge is required, that must be configured in the ingress/Cloudflare, not the backend.

action_items: Optional: harden edge/ingress CORS (Cloudflare rules) so ACAO isn't '*' at the public URL. Not a blocker since browsers only trust one ACAO header and the backend already refuses disallowed origins for actual requests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1356 lines — should be split into routers module (auth/discover/chat/uploads/admin/security) once BLOQUE 3 lands.
_rate_limit_messages queries messages + group_messages collections per call; add a compound index on (from_user, created_at) if not present.
admin/reports sort uses in-memory Python sort; fine for demo scale but should be a DB $sort/pipeline for scaling.
CORSMiddleware config is correct; FRONTEND_URL supports comma-separated values (BLOQUE 2 requirement). Edge proxy behavior is out of app scope.
